description: Type text key by key into the focused element, optionally followed by a key such as Enter. Use fill_by_uid to set the value of a known input; use this for elements that only react to real typing, such as autocomplete fields and rich text editors.

submitKey.description: Key to press after the text, such as "Enter" or "Tab". Same syntax as press_key.

uid.description: Focusable element UID from snapshot to focus before typing (default: the already focused element)

name: type_text
